arguments.command:
cd /app/submission && for f in perf perf2 mem mem2 slow ackmem; do python3 - <<EOF
import subprocess, time, resource, sys, os, json
def limit():
    resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS, (768*1024*1024, 768*1024*1024))
    resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_NOFILE, (64, 64))
start = time.time()
with open("/app/tmp/$f.json","rb") as f, open("/app/tmp/$f.out","wb") as o:
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "entry.py"], stdin=f, stdout=o, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, preexec_fn=limit, cwd="/app/submission")
el = time.time() - start
ru = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
d = json.load(open("/app/tmp/$f.out"))
print("$f: rc=%d wall=%.2fs cpu=%.2fs rss=%.0fMB ok=%s" % (p.returncode, el, ru.ru_utime+ru.ru_stime, ru.ru_maxrss/1024, "results" in d))
EOF
done
